column1: # Normalization applied to upstream's recorded output and to snappea-compat's output before
# they are compared. Read by scripts/record-upstream-goldens.py and
# crates/snappea/tests/compat_check_upstream.rs, so both sides stay in sync.
# Every rule is one line of tab-separated fields:
#   drop <regex>                  remove whole lines that match (console only)
#   mask <regex> <replacement>    replace every match (console and files)
# Regexes use the syntax shared by Python `re` and Rust `regex`. Replacements are literal
# except for `${1}`, `${2}`, ..., the text of a capture group.
# Besides these rules, the working directory is replaced by `<dir>` and a leading UTF-8
# Source discovery: upstream finds the .pproj and the compiled .dll, snappea-compat reads
